items.headline: UNI fee plan gets support
items.what_happened: L2BEAT said it backed a plan to use some Uniswap trading fees to remove UNI tokens from circulation.
items.why_it_matters: This could link use of the exchange to a smaller token supply.
items.risk: A supportive vote does not mean the plan is live or that UNI will rise.

items.headline: Solana payment software gets a refund fix
items.what_happened: The x402 project added a fix intended to make its payment system restore refunds after a server restart.
items.why_it_matters: Reliable refunds matter when apps handle lots of small payments.
items.risk: A code fix does not prove that apps have installed it or that more people are using it.

items.headline: Aave reports more use of its lending service
items.what_happened: Aave said its new lending version had passed US$1 billion in deposits and US$310 million in active loans.
items.why_it_matters: Actual borrowing shows people are using the service, beyond online attention.
items.risk: These figures come from Aave. Its token can fall even when the service grows.
